description: This file contains functions and procedures for configuring and managing a QMI-based mobile broadband interface within a network management system, including initialization, setup, and teardown procedures, along with handling device interactions, SIM status, network registration, and IP configuration.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the QMI protocol, setting up required parameters for device, APN, authentication, and network profiles.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Performs the setup of the QMI network interface, including device validation, SIM and network registration checks, configuration of IP profiles, and establishing data connections.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Handles the cleanup and stopping of the QMI network interface, releasing resources and stopping data links.

methods.name: qmi_wds_stop
methods.description: Stops a specific WDS client ID and network, releasing the data connection associated with it.
